article_title: Ecosystem restoration strengthens pollination network resilience and function

source_design.treatments: four restored and four unrestored sites

weight_families.no_visits: observed visit counts, not corrected for observation time, observed flowers or floral abundance
weight_families.visitfreq: standardized visitation frequency = visits/flower/hour multiplied by floral abundance

network_unit: source-defined site x month network; all 64 networks remain nested within one Seychelles independent system
aggregation_rule: Do not collapse the 64 networks into independent systems. Primary cross-system use retains source-defined site-month rows and withholds all Seychelles rows together. Treatment/month may be retained as measurement/design covariates, not used to select networks by fit.
claim_boundary: Only flower visitors touching reproductive parts were retained by the source. Interaction weights measure visitation frequency/counts, not single-visit effectiveness or plant reproductive success. Primary/secondary weight families are fixed before metric inspection.
